$comment: The bundled PDFium for Windows and Linux (ADR-0018, design.md Decision 7). One tag, the pdfium-render release whose `pdfium_latest` feature binds to it, and the sha256 of each release asset the desktop builds and the core's tests download (scripts/pdfium-fetch.mjs). Checked by scripts/pdfium-pin-check.mjs; bump the tag only with a pdfium-render release that raises `pdfium_latest`.
$verified: Each digest was computed with `shasum -a 256` over the asset downloaded from the release on 2026-10-16, and each matched the digest the GitHub release API reports for that asset. `node scripts/pdfium-pin-check.mjs --upstream` repeats the API half; `--verify <file>` repeats the download half against a tarball on disk. The two macOS assets were added on 2026-10-17 the same way, for the core's PDF tests on a Mac host; no desktop app ships them, since macOS reads PDF through PDFKit.
